<subject>Service Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you know, the Service Agreement has to address [AllianceNet] one-to-many with Maple & Crown and [DataLink] one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need a separate [AllianceNet] General Terms & Conditions one-to-many with Maple & Crown and Separate [DataLink] GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need a single [ConnectPro] application that addresses [NetFlow], both one-to-many.

As soon as these drafts are complete, I would like to read them!

Thanks.

GP
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Travis McCullough <Travis.McCullough@maplecrown.ca>
Sent: Tuesday, July 9, 2024 8:33 PM
To: Lee Mills; Nicholas Porter; John Cummings; Bradley Miller; Douglas Dixon; Harry M Collins; Sandra Wood
Subject: Service Agreement - revised

Attached is a revised version of the Service Agreement omitting the distinction between transactions on [DataLink] and transactions on [AllianceNet]. If Maple & Crown is the only party permitted to post services on [DataLink], there is no need for the special rules that we drafted for what was previously a "many-to-many" matching site. However, we will need to develop a different set of GTCs for transactions that Maple & Crown closes on [DataLink], since the services transacted on [DataLink] are not likely to be the type that lend themselves to Maple & Crown's standard GTCs.
